comparison.objective: Pull a stiff sliding window open by its delicate handle without tearing the handle off or damaging the window.
comparison.physical_skill: Force-limited pulling against velocity-dependent drag through a fragile handle; no precision interface mating, supported block handoff or loose-element containment.
comparison.success_condition: Scores handle-mediated sash travel, with zero for handle or window damage; candidate requires physical rail-jig contact, parallel axes, full block transfer and retention of every ball.
comparison.reason: The shared force-limiting primitive is generic. This record tests pacing a resistive slider below a breakaway-force limit, whereas the candidate tests alignment-preserving transfer across a butt joint. Candidate force and angular thresholds are unspecified, but that does not make these objectives plausible duplicates.
